description: This update makes multiblock cells and machine modules available to UtilityCraft extensions, refreshes recipe books, and fixes hammer drops.
highlights:
- Shared multiblock cells and machine modules are now available in UtilityCraft.
- Hammers correctly crush ores that drop raw materials or gems.
- Primitive Forge Bricks show the assembled forge and an Iron Dust hint.
- Recipe books and machine UI labels are clearer.
